ts-pp1.label: Powerplay batting vs league, 2008–2023
ts-pp1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ts-pp1.query: SELECT SUM(d.total_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 AND i.batting_team_id IN (2,15)

ts-death1.label: Death bowling vs league, 2008–2023
ts-death1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ts-death1.query: SELECT SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15)

ts-toss1.label: Share of won tosses where RCB chose to bowl first, 2008–2023
ts-toss1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ts-toss1.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.toss_decision = 'field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) f, COUNT(*) n FROM matches m WHERE m.toss_winner_id IN (2,15) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023

ts-b1.label: Share of Royal Challengers Bengaluru's batting runs from boundaries, 2008–2023
ts-b1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ts-b1.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs IN (4, 6) THEN d.batter_runs ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(d.batter_runs) b FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023
